title: Assets
purpose: Things you own with a low and high resale value each, and what the total was worth over time.
description: Keep a list of games, DVDs, toys, devices and books. Each item has a low and a high value; the page shows the totals and a low/high bar chart over time.
navigation: Shows total low and high value, item count and items not yet priced
Bar chart of the low and high total by day
Searchable table with category and priced filters, add, set price and mark sold
Barcode box that looks up a name from the number alone
